# Integrations

Integrations let you combine Apify Actors with the rest of your stack - workflow automation platforms, data warehouses, AI agents, and the tools your team already uses. The sections below mirror the integrations sidebar; each links through to the full list.

## Actors

Connect Apify Actors to other Actors and tasks to build multi-step workflows directly on the platform. Set up integration-ready Actors that take run output from an upstream Actor and push it into a downstream system.

https://docs.apify.com/integrations/actors.md

#### [Actor-to-Actor](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/actors.md)

[Trigger other Actors or tasks from your Actor's runs.](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/actors.md)

https://docs.apify.com/integrations/actors/integration-ready-actors.md

#### [Integration-ready Actors](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/actors/integration-ready-actors.md)

[Build Actors that act as integration targets.](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/actors/integration-ready-actors.md)

[See all Actor integrations →](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/actors.md)

## Create a new integration

If you're building a service or platform and want your users to be able to connect it with Apify, [create a new integration](https://docs.apify.com/integrations/integrate.md). The page walks through both routes - building an integration-ready Actor that other Apify users can plug into their workflows, or connecting your service to Apify externally via the API.

If your tool isn't listed above, you can also browse [Apify Store](https://apify.com/store) for community-built integration Actors like [MongoDB Import](https://apify.com/drobnikj/mongodb-import) or [MySQL Insert](https://apify.com/petr_cermak/mysql-insert).
